text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: "Review this pull request for code quality and consistency. Focus on:\n\n1. Ensuring comprehensive @file documentation is restored across:\n   - Popup helpers\n   - Entry points\n   - Models\n   - Search strategies\n   - Views\n\n2. Verify that documentation matches legacy detail level\n\n3. Highlight scoring pipeline steps to maintain historical behavior parity\n\n4. Check for consistent code comments and documentation style\n\n5. Ensure all new or modified code has proper JSDoc comments\n\nPay special attention to:\n- File-level documentation consistency\n- Scoring pipeline clarity and historical behavior preservation\n- Code comment quality and completeness"
          allowed_tools: "web_search"
          max_turns: 5
          model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          anthropic_model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"
          timeout_minutes: 10
          
      - name: Comment on Pull Request
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## Code Review Summary
            
            This pull request has been reviewed by Claude to ensure:
            
            ✅ Comprehensive @file documentation is restored across popup helpers, entry points, models, search strategies, and views
            ✅ Documentation matches legacy detail level
            ✅ Scoring pipeline steps are clearly highlighted for historical behavior parity
            ✅ Code comments and documentation are consistent and complete
            
            Please review the specific suggestions and make any necessary adjustments to maintain code quality and historical behavior consistency.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: claude-review
```
